title: Petition of Essex County Gas Company for approval of and authorization by the Department of Public Utilities (1) for the issuance and sale of $4,00,000 Principal amount of First Mortgage Bonds (1999 Series) to be sold at not less than par and to mature in 1999 and (2) for finding by the Department of Public Utilities that the issue and sale of such Bonds is in the public interest and (3) for an exemption from the competitive bidding requirements of Section 15 of Chapter 164 of the General Laws, as amended, in connection with such issue and sale.
petitioner: Essex Gas Company D/B/A National Grid
